fundamentals.name: Netflix, Inc.
fundamentals.longBusinessSummary: Netflix, Inc. provides entertainment services worldwide. The company offers television (TV) series, documentaries, feature films, games, and live programming across various genres and languages. It also provides members the ability to receive streaming content through a host of internet-connected devices, including TVs, digital video players, TV set-top boxes, and mobile devices. Netflix, Inc. was incorporated in 1997 and is headquartered in Los Gatos, California.

judgment.summary: A high-growth, highly profitable company with strong free cash flow generation, trading at a reasonable forward multiple.
judgment.earningsRecap: Last quarter missed EPS estimates; next earnings date is 2026-07-16.
positives: Revenue growth 16.2% YoY and earnings growth 86.4% YoY indicate strong top and bottom-line expansion.
Profit margin of 28.5% and return on equity of 48.5% demonstrate exceptional profitability and efficiency.
Free cash flow of $25.99B TTM provides significant financial flexibility.
Forward P/E of 20.92x is attractive relative to its growth and profitability.
Analyst consensus is 'buy' with a mean target of $114.15.
negatives: Last quarter missed EPS estimates by 6.9%.
Debt/Equity ratio of 53.79% indicates moderate leverage.
Beta of 1.49 suggests higher volatility than the broader market.

news.paragraph: Netflix is navigating a complex narrative, with Jim Cramer expressing a desire to buy the stock while other reports highlight factors dragging it down. Despite some headwinds, the company is seen as a high-quality compounder poised to maintain its global lead in streaming amidst industry consolidation. Analysts remain largely positive, with a consensus 'buy' rating and a mean target price significantly above the current spot.
